title: sphaeralcea axillaris subsp. violacea
intro: Sphaeralcea axillaris subsp. violacea, commonly known as Violacea or Purple Globe Marigold, is a perennial plant species in the mallow family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant include soothing and calming effects, possibly due to its bioactive constituents, which may include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. However, more research is needed to fully understand the properties and effects of Sphaeralcea axillaris subsp. violacea, and it should be used with caution under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
